research_question: Do age, sex, and receiving help from another chimpanzee influence the nut-cracking efficiency of western chimpanzees?

ivs.description: Age in years at time of observation; predictor tested for effect on nut-cracking efficiency.
Individual's sex (categorical); predictor tested for effect on nut-cracking efficiency.
Received help from another chimpanzee (yes/no); predictor tested for effect on nut-cracking efficiency.

dv.description: Nut-cracking efficiency (nuts opened per second), computed as nuts_opened / seconds.

extracted_analysis.analysis_code:
import pandas as pd
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf

# Load data
_df = pd.read_csv("panda_nuts.csv")

# Define efficiency as nuts opened per second
_df["efficiency"] = _df["nuts_opened"] / _df["seconds"]

# Fit linear model with age, sex, and help as predictors
model = smf.ols("efficiency ~ age + C(sex) + C(help)", data=_df).fit()

# Summaries for interpretation
print("Model summary:\n", model.summary())
print("\nGroup means (efficiency):")
print(_df.groupby(["sex", "help"])['efficiency'].mean())
